args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploy of v2.3.1, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. (The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging.) We rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with an error rate of ~0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions, and it's now passing health checks. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What failed:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) was also marked unhealthy in staging before it went to production.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions are back on it, and the error rate is now about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 says why we rolled back, what we rolled back to, and the result. It notes that the cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
